title: Revyme — Open-source website builder
excerpt: The open-source visual website builder. Design with pixel-perfect control and ship real Next.js code you own — no proprietary format, no lock-in.
content_html:
Design the web,own the code.

Import from Figma

Export your code as Next.js

Deploy to Cloudflare Workers

Open source

The open-source Framer alternative. A pixel-perfect visual builder where your design becomes real Next.js code — fast, SEO-ready, exportable, yours forever.

Visual canvas

Design on a truly infinite canvas. Drag, snap, and align every pixel with real layout — no breakpoints to fight, no rigid grid in your way.

  • A designer-friendly infinite canvas
  • Pixel-perfect control at every breakpoint
  • True control without compromise

Built-in CMS

Turn any layout into a living collection. Model your content once, bind it to the canvas, and every page keeps itself up to date.

  • Typed collections with rich fields and references
  • Bind any element to dynamic content visually
  • Draft, schedule, and publish with one click

Localization

Go global in a click. Translate content inline, switch locales live, and serve the right language to every visitor automatically.

  • Per-locale content, URLs, and SEO metadata
  • Auto-detect and serve the visitor’s language
  • RTL support and locale-aware formatting

Motion & interactions

Add motion without writing a line. Scroll effects, hovers, and page transitions are all designed right on the canvas.

  • Scroll, hover, and click-driven interactions
  • Springs, variants, and scroll-driven effects
  • Page transitions and text effects built in

Code export

Everything compiles to clean Next.js. Export it and run it anywhere — the design was the code all along.

  • Clean Next.js code as you build
  • Self-host on your own servers
  • Export in Tailwind

Built for teams.

Design isn't a solo sport. Bring the whole team onto the same canvas, watch the numbers as you ship, and keep every project in one place — from the first cursor to the live A/B test.

content_html_zh:
设计网页，拥有代码。

从 Figma 导入

将代码导出为 Next.js

部署到 Cloudflare Workers

开源

开源 Framer 替代方案。 一个像素完美的视觉构建器，您的设计成为真正的 Next.js 代码 - 快速、SEO 就绪、可导出，永远属于您。

视觉画布

在真正无限的画布上进行设计。 拖动、对齐每个像素并将其与真实布局对齐 - 无需打断点，也没有严格的网格。

  • 设计师友好的无限画布
  • 每个断点的像素完美控制
  • 真正的控制，毫不妥协

内置内容管理系统

将任何布局变成一个活生生的收藏。 对内容进行一次建模，将其绑定到画布，每个页面都会保持最新状态。

  • 具有丰富字段和引用的类型化集合
  • 将任何元素直观地绑定到动态内容
  • 一键起草、安排和发布

本土化

只需点击一下即可走向全球。 内联翻译内容、实时切换区域设置，并自动为每个访问者提供正确的语言。

  • 每个区域的内容、URL 和 SEO 元数据
  • 自动检测并提供访问者的语言
  • RTL 支持和区域设置感知格式

运动和交互

无需书写线条即可添加动作。 滚动效果、悬停和页面过渡都是在画布上设计的。

  • 滚动、悬停和点击驱动的交互
  • 弹簧、变体和滚动驱动效果
  • 内置页面过渡和文本效果

代码导出

所有内容都会编译为干净的 Next.js。 将其导出并在任何地方运行——设计始终是代码。

  • 在构建时清理 Next.js 代码
  • 在您自己的服务器上自行托管
  • 在 Tailwind 中导出

专为团队打造。

设计不是一项单独的运动。 将整个团队带到同一个画布上，在交付时查看数字，并将每个项目保留在一个位置 - 从第一个光标到实时 A/B 测试。
